checks.label: Its magnitude is obtained by multiplying their magnitudes by the sine of the angle between them: wherever the push is dragged or swung, the moment drawn is |r| times |F| times the sine of the angle between the drawn arrows, the shaded parallelogram has that area, and the readout says so

The direction of the vector product can be determined by the corkscrew right-hand rule: the moment arrow drawn always stands along the bolt, square to both r and F, on the side r × F gives it, in every view he can turn to

With the fingers pointing along r and curled toward F, the extended thumb points in the direction of the cross product: the curl drawn turns from r toward F, and the moment arrow points the thumb's way along the bolt

The dot product is a scalar; the cross product is a vector: every cross product worked out on screen is given with its direction, and an answer that gives the dot product instead is marked wrong and drawn in red

The force on a current-carrying wire in a magnetic field is F = IlB sin θ, its direction given by a right-hand rule: at every angle the wire is turned to, the force drawn is 10 × 0.2 × 0.8 × sin θ and points along the current crossed with the field
The force is perpendicular to the direction of both the current and the magnetic field: on every wire picture the force drawn is square to the wire and to the field

Every number follows from the rule: 0.3 × 150 = 45 N m; 0.2 × 150 = 30 N m; 45 × sin 30° = 22.5 N m, 30 × sin 30° = 15 N m, nothing along the handle, and 22.5 N m into the nut past it; F × r is 45 N m the other way; 10 × 0.2 × 0.8 = 1.6 N, and 0.8 N at 30°; 0.3i × 150j = 45k N m; 4 × 0.25 × 0.5 = 0.5 N along −j; and each wrong answer offered is a slip worked from the same values

As the push swings from square on to along the handle, the moment shrinks at every step, halves at 30° and is nothing along the handle; past it the arrow points into the nut; swapping r and F flips the arrow; and i × j = k, j × k = i, k × i = j, j × i = −k and i × i = 0
Every puzzle offers three different answers with exactly one accepted, gives each wrong one its own hint, and draws a wrong pick in red but a right one without
Before Check no puzzle's picture shows its answer, and a right answer shows it
Every demonstration has finished arriving within 5 s of its screen opening, none starting before the 0.35 s screen fade ends; every answer's motion within 2.5 s
